fact: Chipinge Rural District Council's Strategic Plan for 2025, reviewed at a workshop on 11-13 November 2024, states under its e-government flagship that the whole of the council offices will be connected to LAN and ICT infrastructure established; the passage gives no cost, and it is one council's plan, not a national one.
title: Chipinge Rural District Council Strategic Plan 2025
why_not: parent: one council's uncosted plan for an office network, not a plan naming the connection of local governments
